persistent_component_attribution.formula: For each component: mean over matched block/replicate of sum(epoch0..63 online component)-sum(epoch0..63 frozen component). Positive means higher online cost; opposite sign from savings.
persistent_component_attribution.caveat: Arithmetic attribution only. This does not establish that reward weights are wrong, a causal mechanism, or clinical benefit.

scope: 216 recovery2 evaluation gzip files only; independent Python standard-library arithmetic; no project analysis helper or scientific execution

formulas.cost: math.fsum(raw cost at epochs 0..63); no component substitution
formulas.final_outcomes: count unique epoch63 patient_records by status; require all lost/delivered; cross-check cumulative
formulas.paired_unit: block,condition,replicate; same patient identity set in all six arms
formulas.savings: reference 64-epoch cost minus online_matched_fork 64-epoch cost; positive favors online
formulas.mean_savings: unweighted mean paired savings; 4 worlds per block-condition,12 per condition,36 overall
formulas.mean_relative_savings_percent: mean(100*paired savings/reference cost), not percentage of mean cost
formulas.extra_outcomes: online minus reference; positive extra_lost is worse
formulas.changed_actions: per-world, per-epoch executed committed hours; abs difference >1e-6; exact-nonzero world count also reported
formulas.hours_l1: sum over all64 epochs and4sites of abs(online executed hours-reference executed hours)

raw_hash_aggregate.encoding: UTF-8 concatenation of sorted payload-relative path + TAB + compressed-file SHA256 + LF

caveats: Synthetic development pilot; costs are modeled units, not currency or calibrated clinical evidence.
Three independent training blocks; paired worlds within a block are not independent model fits.
Positive average cost savings with more lost patients is a cost/outcome trade-off, not clinical success.
Changed executed hours demonstrate behavior change, not benefit.
No independent bootstrap/inference rerun; this check validates raw arithmetic and descriptive paired means only.
Archive, process, locks, model seals, training history and source validation are outside this task.
comparison.json has no online_vs_fixed_allocation_reference contrast; that requested contrast is independently added here, not claimed cross-checked against a nonexistent entry.

Against matched-exploration, mean executed-hour L1 changes by training block are approximately 0.01205, 0.05234, and 82.85130 hours per world; counting changed worlds alone conceals this scale difference.

interpretation.arithmetic: All 216 raw trajectory costs and 388 published mean numbers agree exactly; all final patient outcomes reconcile with raw cumulative counts.
interpretation.online_benefit: No consistent positive savings across three blocks in the persistent-change condition for either frozen comparator; every condition has more mean lost patients versus both frozen comparators.
interpretation.primary_overall: Versus frozen_history: +1523.263261753652 modeled cost-unit savings per world but +4.722222222222222 lost / -4.722222222222222 delivered. Versus matched exploration: -18678.86190572298 savings and +3.4444444444444446 lost / -3.4444444444444446 delivered.
interpretation.aggregate_vs_mean_percent: Versus adaptive_rule, overall ratio-of-sums savings is +0.369332%, but mean per-world relative savings is -0.462166%; these are distinct estimands, not an arithmetic inconsistency.
